plan.title: bug(scope): scope:complete does not auto-discover the merged PR for delivery evidence

narratives.Description: bug(scope): scope:complete does not auto-discover the merged PR for delivery evidence
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

`scope:complete` does not auto-discover the merged PR. Delivery evidence (`--repo`, `--pr`, `--merge-commit`, `--pr-base`, `--merged-at`) must be passed explicitly. An agent that omits them gets a late failure **after** the merge has already happened. Those fields are derivable from the branch’s merge commit / the origin issue’s merged pull.

Filed from [comment on closed #3305](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3305#issuecomment-5362873704). **Do not reopen #3305** — this is #3041 leftover, not the namespacing bug.

## Observed

Remediation today (`packages/core/src/scope/delivery-evidence.ts`):

```
Pass scope:complete -- --merge-commit <sha> (and --pr <n> if you have one).
```

Flags are parsed in `packages/core/src/scope/main.ts`. `evidenceFromPrPayload` already exists for `swarm:finalize-cohort` and is **not** wired as a complete-time lookup from the current branch or origin issue.

## Expected (thin v1)

When `--pr` / `--merge-commit` are omitted on a **code-bearing** complete:

1. Resolve the origin GitHub issue from the brief `references`.
2. If that issue has exactly one merged PR into `plan.policy.deliveryBranch` (or the explicit `--delivery-branch`), stamp delivery evidence from that PR (`evidenceFromPrPayload`).
3. If zero or more than one candidate, fail closed with the current explicit-flag remediation (do not guess).

Keep explicit flags as override.

## Non-goals

- Inferring deploy/UAT from Git (already forbidden in delivery provenance).
- Using `--non-delivery` as the happy path for shipped work.
- Changing the #3305 evidence key namespacing.

## Hostile / headless note

Auto-pick of the wrong PR is the failure mode. Zero-or-many → fail closed is the control. Do not silently take the latest PR on the branch if it is not merged to delivery.

## Refs

#3041, #3380, #3305 (comment only).
